cases.purpose: Reject word PID with short option and preserve util-linux failure status.
cases.oracle: Locked util-linux prlimit; status, presence of a diagnostic, and empty stdout.
cases.comparison: Normalize diagnostic text only; compare actual command status and whether stderr and stdout are empty.
cases.script: prlimit -p abc --nofile > out 2> err; rc=$?; [[ -s err ]] && d=yes || d=no; printf "status=%s diagnostic=%s\n" "$rc" "$d"; [[ ! -s out ]] && echo stdout=empty; rm -f out err
